Created a Rust 2021 project in `/output` with the root binary [test11.rs](/output/test11.rs), library modules [lib.rs](/output/lib.rs), [color.rs](/output/color.rs), [cli.rs](/output/cli.rs), [format.rs](/output/format.rs), and [Cargo.toml](/output/Cargo.toml). It preserves the C++ behavior with `f32` math, the same default/argument handling, `std::stof`-style prefix parsing, and `std::cout`-compatible float formatting.

Builds succeeded with both `cargo build --release` and `rustc test11.rs -O -o test11`. The standalone executable is [test11](/output/test11), and the Cargo release binary is [target/release/test11](/output/target/release/test11). I validated stdout byte-for-byte against `/workspace/dataset/test11_executable` on 523 deterministic and random cases with no mismatches.
